cost_provenance: ADVERSE_PROXY_FOR_AN_UNMEASURED_LEG -- repo-measured liquid-name close half-spread is 1.13 bp (t3, 19,835 symbol-days); intraday mega-cap ETF spreads are tighter, so 1.0 bp/side is conservative. The 2.5 bp rung is retail_taker_costs()'s own default half-spread.
regulatory_provenance: BROKER_SCHEDULE -- SEC Section 31 ($27.80/$1M of sales, 0.278 bp sell-side) plus FINRA TAF; charged on every rung
borrow_note: zero because every config is flat at the closing bar; US borrow fees accrue overnight. A variant that held overnight would owe B22G's measured 0.33%/yr ETB median and is not what was tested here.
execution: signal from closes through bar t-1, fill at bar-t VWAP, return vwap[t+1]/vwap[t]-1

null_max_sharpe.method: stationary block bootstrap (block=5 days) of DEMEANED daily PnL, same day indices across all configs so cross-config correlation is preserved

null_max_sharpe_gross.note: same bootstrap on the BEFORE-COST daily PnL -- answers 'is there any signal at all', separately from 'does it survive frictions'
